abstract: BACKGROUND/AIM: The aim of the study was to assess the clinical outcome of patients with malignant transformation of an ovarian mature teratoma. PATIENTS AND METHODS: This study was conducted on 23 patients who underwent primary surgery at three Italian Gynecological Centers. Histologically, nine (39.1%) patients had squamous cell carcinoma, five (21.7%) had a thyroid carcinoma, six (26.1%) had a carcinoid, one (4.3%) patient had papillary renal carcinoma, one (4.3%) had medulloblastoma and one (4.3%) had intestinal-type mucinous adenocarcinoma. RESULTS: All six patients with stage I squamous cell carcinoma had no evidence of disease (NED) after a median time of 141 months. Of the three patients with stage IIb-IIIc squamous cell carcinoma, two had NED after 119 and 154 months, and one died of the disease 9 months after diagnosis. All five women with stage I thyroid carcinoma had NED after a median of 60 months. Of the six patients with stage I carcinoid, five had NED after a median of 168 months, whereas one died due to carcinoid heart disease. The three patients with stage I renal carcinoma, medulloblastoma and mucinous adenocarcinoma had NED after 24, 141 and 149 months, respectively. CONCLUSION: The clinical outcome of early-stage malignancies associated with mature ovarian teratomas is excellent following treatment.

背景／目的：本研究の目的は、卵巣の成熟奇形腫の悪性転化を有する患者の臨床転帰を評価することであった。
患者と方法：イタリアの3施設の婦人科センターで初回手術を受けた23例を対象に実施した。組織学的には、9例(39.1%)が扁平上皮癌、5例(21.7%)が甲状腺癌、6例(26.1%)がカルチノイド、1例(4.3%)が乳頭状腎細胞癌、1例(4.3%)が髄芽腫、1例(4.3%)が腸型粘液性腺癌であった。
結果：病期Iの扁平上皮癌の6例は全例、中央値141か月後に無病(NED)であった。病期IIb-IIIcの扁平上皮癌の3例のうち、2例は119か月後および154か月後に無病であり、1例は診断から9か月後に原病で死亡した。病期Iの甲状腺癌の女性5例は、中央値60か月後に全例無病であった。病期Iのカルチノイドの6例のうち、5例は中央値168か月後に無病であったが、1例はカルチノイド心疾患により死亡した。病期Iの腎細胞癌、髄芽腫、粘液性腺癌の3例は、それぞれ24か月、141か月、149か月後に無病であった。
結論：成熟卵巣奇形腫に関連する早期悪性腫瘍の臨床転帰は、治療後は極めて良好である。
